<USER_REQUEST>
You are working in the NeuroTraffic repo (FastAPI + YOLOv8 backend in backend/, Flutter app in traffic_ai_app/). A review found the issues below. Fix them in order. After each fix run `python -m compileall -q -x venv backend` and `pytest backend/tests`. Do not scan or compile backend/venv. At the end give me a per-issue summary of what changed and which tests cover it. Do not change behavior beyond what is listed.

NOTE (Windows/PowerShell): there is no `grep`. Use Select-String and exclude venv, e.g.
Get-ChildItem backend -Recurse -Include *.py | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch "\\venv\\" } | Select-String "pattern"

1. CROP BUG (most important)
   YOLO runs on a downscaled frame (DETECTION_RESIZE_WIDTH, default 640). In detection/pipeline.py the raw ultralytics `box` (downscaled coordinates) is passed together with the FULL-size `frame` into check_helmet_and_alert, check_seatbelt_and_alert, check_plate_and_save, log_full_detection, and into the alert/evidence code (check_overspeed, check_wrong_way, check_lane_departure, check_red_light_violation, save_and_push_alert). Crops are therefore taken from the wrong region.
   - Add a small class FullFrameBox(x1, y1, x2, y2) in pipeline.py that exposes `.xyxy = [(x1, y1, x2, y2)]` in FULL-frame pixels, built from the already-rescaled x1..y2 values.
   - Pass FullFrameBox (never the raw box) everywhere above.
   - Make a `clean_frame = frame.copy()` once per detection pass BEFORE any cv2.rectangle/putText drawing, and pass clean_frame (not frame) to all background tasks and to evidence capture, so crops never contain drawn overlays and tasks don't race with drawing.
   - Add a test that builds a 1280x720 frame with a distinctive colored rectangle at a known position, simulates the 640px downscale, and asserts the crop used by the plate/helmet/evidence path contains that rectangle.

2. BLOCKING CALLS ON THE EVENT LOOP
   - In detection/pipeline.py (around the whole-frame checks), call get_current_lane_polygons and check_potholes through `await asyncio.to_thread(..., camera_id, frame.copy())`.
   - save_and_push_alert may now run in a worker thread. In alerts.py keep a module-level `_main_loop`, add set_main_loop(loop) (called once at the start of run_camera_pipeline with asyncio.get_running_loop()), and use `asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(broadcast(...), _main_loop)` when there is no running loop in the current thread. Remove the asyncio.get_event_loop() fallback.
   - Move the evidence-photo cv2.imwrite and the Firebase push out of the event-loop path (run them with asyncio.to_thread or inside the worker thread).

3. SECURE DEFAULTS
   - auth.py: remove the "insecure-dev-key-change-me" fallback. If JWT_SECRET_KEY is unset, generate secrets.token_urlsafe(48) for this process and print a clear warning. Make config.py not define its own JWT secret (auth.py is the single source of truth).
   - main.py CORS: keep allow_origins=["*"] only if allow_credentials=False. Better: read ALLOWED_ORIGINS from env (comma-separated), default to ["*"] with credentials False.
   - Replace "first registered user becomes admin" with: admin only if the email is listed in the ADMIN_EMAILS env var. Update the README and tests.

4. HELMET / SEATBELT CONFIRMATION
   Currently the "3 consecutive checks" happen on consecutive detection frames (~0.13s apart) with nearly identical crops, tripling API cost and confirming little.
   - Space confirmation checks: for a given (camera, track) allow at most one check per CONFIRM_INTERVAL_SEC (default 1.0, in config.py), using time.monotonic().
   - Add an in-flight set so only one API call per (camera, track) runs at a time.
   - Cap total API attempts per track (MAX_API_ATTEMPTS, default 8, in config.py); this must be larger than CONSECUTIVE_VIOLATION_CHECKS.
   - A None result (API error / no prediction) must not count as a violation, must not reset the counter, and must not mark the track as checked.
   - A "with_helmet"/"with_seatbelt" result resets the counter and marks the track as checked (as now).
   - Add tests with a mocked API for: 3 spaced violations -> alert; 2 violations then OK -> no alert; None results -> no alert and retry allowed; attempts capped.

5. SPEED ON FILES VS LIVE STREAMS
   - Position history currently stores time.monotonic(). For file sources, inference is slower than playback so speeds come out too low. For file sources store `frame_count / fps` as the timestamp; for live sources (is_live_stream) keep monotonic time. Keep speed.py working on (timestamp_seconds, x, y) tuples (remove the legacy integer-frame branch that guesses by type).
   - Homography: use the bottom-center ground point (cx, y2) instead of the box center when calculating speed, wrong-way displacement and lane checks that use homography. Keep (cx, cy) for drawing and line crossing.
   - Test: a vehicle moving a known distance over a known time gives the expected km/h for both timestamp modes.

6. ALERT REVIEW FLOW AND CHALLAN
   - Define ALLOWED_STATUSES = {"new", "reviewed", "dismissed", "challan_issued"} in one place. POST /alerts/{id}/resolve must reject anything outside {"reviewed", "dismissed"} with 422, and require the admin role (get_admin_user) or a "reviewer" role (add a role check helper).
   - GET /alerts/{id}/challan must be read-only: it only generates the PDF for alerts with status "reviewed" or "challan_issued" and violation types. It must NOT change status.
   - Add POST /alerts/{id}/challan/issue (admin only) that requires status "reviewed", sets "challan_issued", and returns the PDF download URL.
   - Update the Flutter app (api_service.dart, alerts_screen.dart) to call the issue endpoint first, then open the PDF URL; show a clear message when the alert is not reviewed yet.
   - Tests: viewer cannot resolve; invalid status -> 422; challan GET on a "new" alert -> 400; GET does not change status; issue endpoint transitions status.

7. DATA RETENTION AND DEPENDENCIES
   - Extend cleanup_old_face_data (or add cleanup_old_evidence) to also delete violations/ files older than EVIDENCE_RETENTION_DAYS (default 30) and null out Alert.evidence_path for deleted files. Run it with the same startup + 6-hour scheduler. Do not delete evidence for alerts whose status is "challan_issued" before 180 days.
   - Add violations/ and captured_faces/ to .gitignore. If backend/venv is tracked, tell me the `git rm -r --cached backend/venv` command (do not run it).
   - requirements.txt: pin numpy<2 (compatible with torch==2.3.1 / torchvision==0.18.1).
   - Make sure every datetime comparison against DB timestamps works on SQLite (naive) and Postgres: either store timezone-aware UTC consistently via a TypeDecorator or convert to naive UTC before comparing. Add a test for the retention cutoff on in-memory SQLite.

8. README
   - Update the README endpoint table, .env example (ADMIN_EMAILS, JWT_SECRET_KEY, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, CONFIRM_INTERVAL_SEC, retention variables) and the "Data & Privacy" section (evidence photos included) to match the code.

ACCEPTANCE: `pytest backend/tests` passes with the new tests, compileall passes on project code only, `flutter analyze` shows no new errors, and no code path passes a raw ultralytics box together with the full-size frame. Search for any remaining `box=box` / `, box)` uses in pipeline.py and confirm they all use FullFrameBox.

</USER_REQUEST>
